text:
Maya: quick idea: add a 'semantic healthguard' to trigger fallbacks on quality signals, not just latency/errors.
Tom: what signals are we talking about? factuality/safety/hallucination?
Maya: all three. plan: sample ~1% of live requests, run a tiny evaluator on rotating golden prompts + tenant seeds, keep a rolling score and flip routing when it drops below threshold.
Rachel: product likes preventing bad outputs. what's the 'safe variant'?
Maya: deterministic decoding + smaller quantized model + stricter output filters. keep latency comparable.
Tom: evaluator cost/latency concerns. sync or async?
Maya: async. evaluator writes metrics to a rolling window; router subscribes and makes decisions.
Kevin: need hysteresis to avoid flapping. define window and cooldown.
Maya: sketch: window=5m, min_samples=50, trigger if median(score)<0.72 and p95_drop>0.12, cooldown=10m.
Tom: evaluator should be a tiny distill model on CPU to save cost.
Maya: yes. also we should randomize prompt selection and rotate golden set to prevent gaming.
Rachel: who curates golden prompts? ops access?
Maya: shared curation by Eng-ML + Product; tenants can opt-in to upload seed prompts (anonymized).
Tom: combine signals into a weighted expression: combined = alpha*semantic + beta*safety_count + gamma*latency_penalty. example: {"alpha":0.7,"beta":0.2,"gamma":0.1,"threshold":0.65}.
Tom: how does this interact with canary/A-B? precedence/dup detection?
Maya: precedence: infra errors > latency SLOs > semantic guard > manual. semantic guard shouldn't flip core canaries that already own >30% traffic unless explicitly allowed.
Tom: telemetry: per-route dashboard with eval trend, sample counts, triggered flip events, sample diffs (redacted). emit events: semantic.health.<model>.<region> with {score,samples,reason} (scrubbed/rate-limited).
Maya: console: add 'Semantic Health' card, traffic marker when flipped, force-unflip button. shadow safe variant for 30s on flip to gather diffs before full cut.
Kevin: ops: emergency kill-switch + auto-escalation if >3 auto-switches in 24h. add playbook entries.
Maya: rollout: RFC -> internal pilot with one non-critical model and a few tenants -> expand if false-positive rate <2% and cost <5% of inference spend.
Kevin: I'll add recovery steps and postmortem checklist.
Maya: I'll draft a lightweight RFC with config schema, dashboard mockups, and pilot checklist. ping me to join pilot.
Rachel: thanks all :thumbsup:
eval-bot: scheduled evaluator deployed to staging at 2024-11-07T15:12:00Z (build 0.3.1).
